records.title: SkillSafetyBench: Evaluating Agent Safety under Skill-Facing Attack Surfaces
records.reason: SkillSafetyBench evaluates attack surfaces and safety of agent skills; it is an evaluation benchmark, not an LLM inference efficiency method.

records.title: SkillGraph: Skill-Augmented Reinforcement Learning for Agents via Evolving Skill Graphs
records.reason: Read the primary skill-graph RL method and experiments. SkillGraph uses reinforcement learning and evolving skill graphs for agents; graph-restricted skill retrieval may reduce inference cost, but the paper is chiefly a training/skill acquisition framework and notes extra inference cost for its teacher-driven graph evolution, so net inference-efficiency relevance remains unclear.

records.title: OGLS-SD: On-Policy Self-Distillation with Outcome-Guided Logit Steering for LLM Reasoning
records.reason: OGLS-SD is an on-policy self-distillation training approach for reasoning; the primary abstract describes training optimization and does not establish inference cost/latency improvement.

records.title: ReVSI: Rebuilding Visual Spatial Intelligence Evaluation for Accurate Assessment of VLM 3D Reasoning
records.reason: ReVSI rebuilds an evaluation benchmark for VLM 3D spatial reasoning; it does not contribute an inference efficiency or serving method.

records.title: Toward Autonomous Long-Horizon Engineering for ML Research
records.reason: The paper targets autonomous long-horizon engineering for ML research as an agent task; no concrete LLM inference runtime/resource optimization is indicated.
